# ona_project_policy (Resource)

Grants a group a role on a project. One resource per project/group pair. Members also need access to a runner the project uses before they can start environments; see `ona_runner_policy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_project_policy" "platform_editor" {
  project_id = ona_project.example.id
  group_id   = ona_group.platform.id
  role       = "PROJECT_ROLE_EDITOR"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group the role is granted to.
- `project_id` (String) Project the group is granted access to.
- `role` (String) Role granted to the group: `PROJECT_ROLE_ADMIN`, `PROJECT_ROLE_EDITOR` or `PROJECT_ROLE_USER`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Policy identifier in the form `<project-id>/<group-id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_project_policy.platform_editor <project-id>/<group-id>
```
